risk_summary: The excerpt reports materially weaker performance, including a 5% sales decline, lower margins, sharply higher interest expense, increased indebtedness, product supply disruptions, destocking, competitive pressure, and bad-debt exposure. Risk disclosure is broad and partly boilerplate, while the omission of the 2022-versus-2021 discussion and an apparent period-reference error reduce transparency. Quantified operating results provide useful specificity, but substantial reliance on estimates and generalized uncertainties remains.
